head.t: Siemens Healthineers starts carving out its in vitro diagnostics business, to be named Olyrian Diagnostics
head.x: Siemens Healthineers said on 05/11/2026 that it has started the carve-out of its in vitro diagnostics business, which will be renamed Olyrian Diagnostics in stages and become a standalone company.

head.t: Siemens Healthineers plans to rename itself Healthineers as Siemens prepares to spin off the company in 2027
head.x: Siemens Healthineers said on 05/11/2026 that it will change its name to Healthineers.

head.t: Framework ending 12 October 2027: Blood Collection Devices
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "Siemens Healthcare Diagnostics Limited". 19 suppliers on the framework.

head.t: Framework ending 31 July 2027: Digital Diagnostic Solutions
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "Siemens Healthcare Limited". 54 suppliers on the framework.
